en.headline: Police seize 3.6 kg of cocaine worth HK$2.9 million in Sau Mau Ping public housing
en.dek: A 48-year-old man was arrested on suspicion of trafficking dangerous drugs after officers raided a unit used as a storage and distribution centre.
body: Central District anti-triad officers mounted an anti-narcotics operation on Friday and uncovered a suspected drug storage warehouse inside a public housing unit in Sau Mau Ping.

Police arrested a 48-year-old local man on suspicion of trafficking dangerous drugs. Inside the flat they recovered more than 60 packets of suspected cocaine weighing about 3.6 kilograms, together with electronic scales and resealable plastic bags. The drugs have an estimated street value of about HK$2.9 million.

Investigators believe a trafficking syndicate had been using the densely populated public housing unit as a storage and dispatch point to supply entertainment venues on Hong Kong Island and in Kowloon, hoping the location would complicate detection. Police said the operation successfully stopped the drugs from reaching the market.
Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, trafficking is a serious offence punishable by a maximum of life imprisonment and a fine of HK$5 million.

zh.headline: 警搗秀茂坪公屋毒品倉檢3.6公斤可卡因市值290萬 拘48歲男
zh.dek: 中區反三合會行動組人員在公屋單位檢獲逾60包懷疑可卡因及電子磅等工具，疑犯涉嫌販運危險藥物被扣查。
body: 中區警區反三合會行動組人員周五展開反毒品行動，成功搗破一個位於秀茂坪區內的懷疑毒品儲存倉。
行動中，人員在區內一個公屋單位拘捕一名48歲本地男子，涉嫌販運危險藥物，現正被扣留調查。單位內檢獲一些電子磅、大量可再封膠袋及超過60包懷疑可卡因，合共重約3.6公斤，市值約290萬元。
調查顯示，該批毒品主要供應予港島區及九龍區的娛樂場所。警方相信有販毒集團利用人口稠密的公屋單位作掩飾，作為毒品儲存倉及派送中心，企圖增加追查難度。是次行動已成功阻截該批毒品流入市面。
警方重申，根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物屬極嚴重罪行，一經定罪最高可判終身監禁及罰款500萬元。
